n0.speaker: Silas
n0.text: Morning, Doctor. Nine sharp. Same time tomorrow, I expect?
n0.aside: He is looking at your hands, not your face.

choices.text: "Good morning! Sorry, do I know you?"

n1.text: A gold crown on his lower left molar. Old work. Beautiful work. Nobody makes them like this any more.

choices.text: "Nothing wrong with it. You're all done."

n2.speaker: Silas
n2.aside: A beat. His eyes do something. "Your grandfather's. Of course. That's what I meant."

choices.text: "The old chart says that crown was placed for a T. Rook."
"Everyone says it's the best crown in town."

n3_rook.speaker: Silas
n3_rook.text: Rook kept good clocks. Terrible teeth. Nothing to do with me, Doctor.
n3_rook.aside: He hums four notes under his breath, and doesn't notice. Inside your head, a small, dry voice: "Write that down."

n3_warm.speaker: Silas
n3_warm.text: That's kind. Most days I forget it's there. Most days I forget a lot of things, and they're always the same things.

end_quiet.text: He pays in exact change, as always. At the door he stops and, without turning, waves at the lake.

n0.speaker: Bea
n0.aside: She presses a warm paper bag into your hands. Cinnamon. A note: "Hope you stay."

n1.speaker: Bea
n1.text: Oh, everything's a little early this year. Funny how it goes.

choices.text: (Take the loaf. Notice she doesn't blink.)

n2.speaker: Bea
n2.text: Somebody should. You've got a look about you, like you're about to do something brave.

end.text: Not one cavity. Bea has never had a cavity.

n0.speaker: Cal
n0.text: Hi. Sorry, weird question. Do I know you?

choices.text: "Cal, it's Mags. You're due a cleaning."

n1.speaker: Cal
n1.text: It says here, in my own handwriting: "M. Pell. Dentist. Friend. Do not let her go." So that's you.
n1.aside: He turns the notebook towards you. The ink is fresh. Under it, in a different hand, someone has crossed out a word.

end.text: Cal writes something small in the notebook as he leaves. You can't read it. You don't need to.
